history.title: History of {{name}}
history.description: Who managed the team and who belonged to it, day by day. Dates are inclusive. This page is the record only: access rights, notifications and reports always follow today's structure.
history.startHint: Leave empty for since before records began.
history.endHint: Last day, inclusive. Leave empty if open-ended.
history.loadFailed: Failed to load the team history
history.errorPermission: You don't have permission to change the team structure.
history.errorGone: The team or period no longer exists.
history.errorConflict: This change conflicts with an existing period.
history.errorInvalid: Some of the values are invalid. Check the dates and try again.
history.saveFailed: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.

managers.heading: Managers
managers.hint: A team has exactly one manager on every day. Adding a manager from a date splits the period that date falls in; each period ends the day before the next one starts.
managers.addTitle: Add a manager from a date
managers.addHint: The new manager takes over from the start date; the previous manager stays until the day before.
managers.editHint: Change who manages the team from the period's start, or move the start date. The end follows the next period.
managers.deleteMessage: Delete the period of {{name}} ({{range}})? The previous period absorbs its days.
managers.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the manager period

members.heading: Membership history
members.hint: Every period a person belonged to the team, newest first. A person can rejoin later as a new period; periods of the same person cannot overlap.
members.addHint: Back-dated and future dates are allowed. A manager cannot be a member of their own team on the same day.
members.editHint: Correct the dates; the person stays the same.
members.endBeforeStart: The last day cannot be before the first day.
members.deleteMessage: Delete the membership of {{name}} ({{range}})? They will no longer appear as a member for those days.
members.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the membership period
